# Miami Beach Runner - Unity 3D endless runner

A Subway Surfers style game built from the "Subway Surfers Classic City" design deck, re-themed to a
Miami Beach sunset: neon boardwalk, Ocean Drive art-deco hotels, palms, lifeguard towers, ocean and sailboats.
**No external art or audio files are needed** - all models, textures, UI and sounds are generated by code.

## Open it (2 ways)
**A. Open the folder directly** - Unity Hub > Add > select `MiamiBeachRunner`. Use Unity 2021.3 LTS or newer
(2022.3 LTS and Unity 6 tested by design). Accept the version prompt.
**B. Copy into your own project** - create a new 3D (Built-in or URP) project and copy this `Assets` folder over its `Assets`.

On first import the editor script creates the scenes, sets Build Settings and opens `MainMenu`.
If it does not: menu **Miami Runner > Rebuild Scenes and Build Settings**. Then press **Play**
(or **Miami Runner > Play From Main Menu**).

## Controls
| Action | Keyboard | Touch / mouse |
|---|---|---|
| Change lane | A / D or Left / Right | swipe left / right |
| Jump | Space / W / Up | swipe up |
| Slide | S / Down | swipe down |
| Pause | Esc / P | pause button |

## Game flow (as in the deck)
MainMenu -> StageSelect -> Information (controls + loading) -> Gameplay. Fade in/out between scenes.
Crash -> stumble, camera shake, red flash, Game Over screen (score, distance, coins, best).
Keys revive you (cost 1, 2, 4, 8 keys per revive in one run) with 3 seconds of invincibility.
Coins, keys and best distance are saved with PlayerPrefs (`SavedCoins`, `SavedKeys`, `SavedDistance`).
Difficulty rises with distance: EASY < 500 m, MEDIUM < 1500 m, HARD after; speed ramps from 11 to 26 m/s.

## Obstacles
- **Beach tram** (full height): change lane.  - **Striped beach barrier** (low): jump.
- **Neon overhead sign** (high): slide under.
Every row keeps a "safe lane" that moves at most one lane, so every layout is passable.

## Script map (names from the deck)
Core: `GameConfig`, `GameInput`, `Mats`, `SaveLoad`, `MasterLevelInfo`, `UnityUtil`
Player: `PlayerMovement`, `CollisionDetect`, `CameraFollow`, `RunnerModel`
World: `SegmentGenerator`, `TrackSegment`, `WorldBuilder`, `WorldSetup`, `SkyDome`, `Prim`, `WorldText`,
`Obstacle`, `CollectableRotate`, `CoinCollection` (CollectCoin), `KeyCollection` (KeyCollect), `Debris`, `Bob`
Scenes: `MainMenuControl`, `StageControls`, `LoadToStage`, `GameplayController`, `ScenicRun`, `SceneBootstrap`
UI/Audio: `UIKit`, `Fade`, `AudioManager` (Master 100 / Music 70 / SFX 80 defaults)
Editor: `ProjectSetup`

## Tweaking
- Speed / jump / gravity: fields on `PlayerMovement`.  - Obstacle density: `TrackSegment.BuildObstacleRows`.
- Colours: `GameConfig`.  - Segment length / look-ahead: `GameConfig.SegmentLength`, `SegmentGenerator`.
- Performance on weak devices: lower `SegmentGenerator.spawnAhead`, disable shadows in `WorldSetup`.

## Building
File > Build Settings (scenes are already listed). PC, Mac, Android and iOS work; touch swipes are built in.
The editor adds the shaders it needs to *Always Included Shaders*, so runtime materials survive builds.
